post.description: Creates an authenticated Centrifugo connection token; it never creates or joins a lobby.
Renews one client lease; reconnecting does not create membership.

delete.description: Releases one client lease without leaving durable membership.
Leaves durable membership across client instances.

put.description: ready is required; false explicitly clears readiness.

post.description: Starts an eligible lobby and freezes its roster. The host can start once at least two members are present and every member has chosen a team, is ready and is connected; otherwise it fails with not_ready. The snapshot's start_rules list the game's extra conditions: with every_team_needs_member, a lobby with an empty team fails with empty_teams, whose team_ids name the empty teams.

put.description: team_id is required and may be null to clear the selection.

post.description: Creates a lobby. The optional game_settings object is checked by the game now; invalid settings fail with invalid_game_settings. The lobby stores the settings without reading them and returns them in every snapshot, including the started one. They can't change after creation. Repeating the same request_id and payload within the idempotency window, 24 hours by default, returns the committed snapshot. The lobby is deleted, in any phase, once nobody has been connected to it for an hour, and in any case a day after creation, unless its game sets other times.
Joins by game key and join code; started lobbies allow only frozen-roster rejoin.
Creates one guest identity and bearer credential.
